summary:
Ground truth is origin/main 15e78e276, read at /Users/slimydog/Antiek/platform/.claude/worktrees/ground-main-20260924. node_modules is absent from that checkout, so every vitest claim below is NOT RUN. Everything else is READ or PR evidence, plus PRIOR screenshots that I opened but did not re-render.

**Reading as its own product works.**
- `/read/:documentId` (BookReader) is reachable from the Library, the personal space (`/readings`, `/meta-readings`), meta-reading citations, Sources upload, AutoNotebook, and Write's trace-to-source.
- It has TOC pagination, the shared FloatMenu (Note, Dialogue, Search, Deep-research), a reading companion rail, multi-turn talk-to-book, voice notes, the arXiv T2/T3 link-back frame and a gate-aware body.
- Sanitized reader HTML renders through ReadingColumn when a current-version sidecar exists.
- Limit: BookReader only opens documents that have a `book_assets` row (`GET /books/{id}` returns 404 otherwise). Web/URL ingests and `/ingest/asset` conversions don't create one, so research-found web sources fail with "That book isn't in the library."

**Reading as an embedded feature is mostly missing, and in places it is broken.**
- **One real embed.** A `reader` window kind (from the #3384 cherry-pick of #2838) opens BookReader in a floating, draggable window. The only caller is the Deep Research canvas's "read source" button. It is reachable only after "view as canvas", which opens the first completed research only.
- **Unused payload.** The window's `evidenceSourceContext` payload is never read, so the reader doesn't scroll to or highlight the cited passage.
- **Research workstation (`/inv/:id`).** No reader pane. Citations open ChunkModal, which shows the chunk text in a modal. Its "Open in document viewer" is a plain link that reloads the page into `/wrestle/:id`, and that route shows the "Load a PDF" upload screen for any document id, because no endpoint serves PDF bytes by id.
- **Other broken doors.** ⌘-click on a named source, ⌘-click on a ProjectTree document, and the Notebook RegionEmbed "Open at page" all open a floating PdfViewer panel without `pdfBytes`. The panel can only fail. PdfViewer also renders page 1 only and ignores `initialPage`.
- **Notebook claims.** ClaimCardBlock "Inspect" opens a ClaimInspector panel. That panel passes `claimId` where ClaimCard expects a full `claim` object, so it throws on `claim.text`.
- **Write.** Citation chips navigate the whole page to `/read/:id`; nothing opens in place.
- **ProjectTree, the ⌘K document results, the DocumentsIndex rows and the Read "Library" tab** all route to `/wrestle`.

**The highlight-to-island gesture was removed from the reader.** On 2026-09-18, commit 2ff9518e6 replaced the reader's in-place floating ChaseThread with spin-research followed by a navigation to `/inv/:id`. A failed spin is only logged to the console.
- As a result, the reading companion's whole "Saved chases → draft merge → preview/commit/restore source merge" chain is unreachable. It lists chase handoffs whose parent is `read-<documentId>`, and on main only ChaseThread writes those handoffs, to localStorage. Nothing in the reader opens ChaseThread any more.
- The server-side passage→research links (`researches_for_passage`) have no endpoint and no UI.

**What state persists:**
- **Position:** page index per document in sessionStorage (per tab, lost when the tab closes).
- **Talk-to-book thread:** also sessionStorage.
- **Windows:** in memory only.
- **Notes:** marginalia notes are durable events, shown in the reader companion and promoted to per-book insight nodes.
- **Highlights:** never saved with offsets, so none are ever painted back onto the text.

**Where the fixes are:**
- The planned one-Reader / `openDocument` convergence (antiek-reader SPR-01..09) exists only on unmerged branches `caffen/RDR-SPR-09@d1ab66f35` and `reader/integration@1d3f22c29`.
- The `/wrestle` deep-link dead end is addressed only on the unmerged `design/w7-crashes-20260924` branch (commit 1b8d637ef).
- The prose layer is only on `design/w3-shell-states-prose-20260923`.

TalkToBook's launcher and panel are viewport-fixed (TalkToBook.tsx:258,273). In a window they escape the frame or jump between frame and viewport depending on focus (backdrop-blur containing block): PLAUSIBLE, NOT MEASURED.

The ReadingCompanion source-merge UI is a stack of mono checkbox receipts ('Reviewed draft · create receipt only', 'copy review'). It exposes pipeline vocabulary on a reading surface (ReadingCompanion.tsx:315-420).
No loading skeleton or motion for reader windows arriving from evidence; the arrival choreography PR #2846 is open.
There are no reader keyboard affordances (page turn, focus the reader, cycle windows), which falls short of the PostHog 'every state designed / physics' bar.
risks: Four shipped doors lead into guaranteed failures: /wrestle/:id upload dead end, a byte-less PdfViewer panel (MasterMdViewer ⌘-click, ProjectTree ⌘-click, Notebook RegionEmbed), a ClaimInspector crash, and BookReader 404 on non-book documents. Any mothership work that adds entry points without fixing the resolver multiplies these.

Two panel/window systems exist: WorkspaceStore panels (PanelLayout) and windowsStore windows (WindowsLayer). They have different z-bases, cycling and persistence. Building the reader island on the wrong one repeats the Track A / Track B split recorded in antiek-reading-convergence.

The 2026-09-18 regression (2ff9518e6) silently orphaned the ReadingCompanion merge chain. Tests still pass because the companion is tested with seeded localStorage handoffs (ReadingCompanion.test.tsx, NOT RUN). This is a vacuous-gate pattern.

Spin-research lineage events all go to one global 'read-spin' investigation (passage_research.py:140). Per-document thread discovery will scan an ever-growing trajectory unless it is re-keyed per document.

readingFocus is a process-wide singleton (lib/readingFocus.ts). With several reader windows, the Thought Partner gets the last-mounted or wrongly cleared context, which can mislead answers. §9.0 still holds because gated pages publish no body.
Chase handoffs and talk threads live in localStorage/sessionStorage. That breaks the operator's 'process and outcome stored, not lost' requirement and can't be seen by Claude or other devices.
The unmerged antiek-reader branches (June 2026, 26 commits off main) look finished in their handoff docs ('REAL'). A later agent could believe openDocument exists; the files are absent on main.
